headline: Singapore Core Inflation Moderates to 2% in September
summary: Singapore's core inflation slowed to 2.0% year-on-year in September from 2.2% in August. Data from the Monetary Authority of Singapore and the Ministry of Trade and Industry showed price increases moderated across retail goods and services.
why: Core inflation is the primary price metric monitored by the Monetary Authority of Singapore to evaluate exchange-rate monetary policy settings in the regional financial hub.
